battle.name: 中原大戰
battle.theater: 中原三線戰場：隴海、平漢、津浦
battle.brief: 1930年10月起，閻錫山、馮玉祥聯軍與蔣介石中央軍在豫、魯、冀三省沿隴海、平漢、津浦三條鐵路對抗，歷時約半年。中央軍以空軍支援與德械教導總隊攻取鄭州、開封、濟南，聯軍主力潰散。卡面的線膛野砲是近代野砲的源頭，其射程與火力優勢，正是這場以鐵路樞紐為核心的炮火較量的技術底子。

kit.name: 線膛砲
kit.history: 線膛讓同樣的藥量走得更遠。砲兵第一次可以在射程上贏步兵。

countries: 交戰是同一個中華民國內部、兩套軍隊體系的正面對撞。南京國民政府一方，蔣介石以國民政府軍總司令兼陸軍總司令身份統率，軍政部長何應欽掌軍令、編制與人事，參謀本部主持作戰計畫，兵員以中央軍直屬各師為主，另有各省保安團與地方民團，番號、軍餉、徵購方式正逐步收歸中央。作戰上蔣把大軍分佈在三條鐵路：平漢線由劉峙一線自武漢北上，津浦線由蔣鼎文一線自徐州北進，隴海線由徐源泉一線自蚌埠西推，教導總隊直屬南京待命，充當全軍先鋒與攻堅骨幹。反蔣聯軍一方，閻錫山任北方聯軍總司令，據平津與山西、綏遠，以晉綏軍為骨幹；馮玉祥掌西北軍與陝軍第二集團系統，兵多糧少，駐兵陝甘一帶，與楊虎城第十七路軍同處關中；李宗仁、白崇禧代表廣西新桂系，名義入聯而主力留在兩廣；山東韓復榘、河北龐炳勳等部屬馮系。東北張學良拒絕出兵，聯軍在名義上的北方大本營與三處實際戰場之間，自始缺乏可以貫徹的統一指揮。
countriesEn: The clash was between two armed systems inside a single Republic of China. On the Nanjing government side Chiang Kai-shek commanded as commander in chief of the Nationalist armed forces and chief of the Land Forces, the minister of war Ho Ying-chin held the portfolios of command, establishment and appointments, and the General Staff Department directed operational planning; the manpower of the army was drawn mainly from the divisions of the central army, supplemented by provincial security brigades and local militia, while unit designations, pay and procurement were being steadily brought under central control. For operations Chiang distributed his main force along three railways: the line of Liu Chih advanced north along the Pinghan railway from Hankou, the line of Chiang Ting-wen moved north along the Jinpu railway from Xuzhou, and the line of Hsü Yuan-chuan pushed west along the Longhai railway from Bengbu, with the Training Corps attached directly to Nanjing and held in reserve as the vanguard and the shock troops of the whole army. On the side of the anti-Chiang coalition Yen Hsien-shan was commander in chief of the northern coalition, holding Peking and Tientsin with Shansi and Suiyuan and building its core on the Shansi-Suiyuan army; Feng Yuxiang held the Northwestern Army and the Second Group Army system of the Shaanxi troops, numerous in men but short of food and pay, stationed in Shaanxi and Kansu together with Yang Hucheng's Seventeenth Route Army in the Kuanchung area; Li Zongren and Bai Chongxi represented the Kwangsi clique, nominally in the coalition but keeping their main strength in the two Kwangsi provinces; Han Fuji's troops in Shantung and Pang Ping-hsien's troops in Hopei belonged to the Feng faction. Zhang Xueliang in the Northeast refused to send troops, and from the outset the coalition lacked any unified command capable of being carried through between its nominal northern base and the three real battlefields.
people: 蔣介石是這場戰爭的另一面，他以總司令身份坐鎮蚌埠、徐州一線的行營，把鐵路調度與攻勢節奏抓在自己手上；何應欽以軍政部長身份管軍制與後勤，是中央軍統一編制的推手；參謀總部的蔣百里等人參與制定三線進攻計畫。戰線上，劉峙在平漢線指揮，蔣鼎文在津浦線作戰，徐源泉在隴海線施壓，教導總隊及其後身各師的指揮官延續了這支新式部隊的攻勢作戰傳統。聯軍方面，閻錫山坐鎮北平，以經營山西多年老底子的晉綏軍為核心，圖謀重整北方；馮玉祥被推為西路總指揮，是聯軍的實際精神領袖，其部將張之江、孫連仲分掌主力，手下但凡有兵有餉就打仗，遇缺糧則各自散兵，指令屢屢走不通；楊虎城以十七路軍守西安，是關中一支可以左右戰局的棋子。關鍵人物還有張學良，他一改前言不援閻，使閻失去最大外援；韓復榘、石友三受南京方面的現金與委任，聯軍陣營因此在最要緊的時候裂開；李宗仁與白崇禧始終把兩廣實力留在手裡，不肯把桂系全部押上；陳濟棠在廣東自成一格，日後倒向南京。
peopleEn: Chiang Kai-shek was the other face of this war. As commander in chief he sat at the forward headquarters along the line of Bengbu and Xuzhou and kept the railway scheduling and the tempo of the offensive in his own hands; Ho Ying-chin, as minister of war, controlled the military system and the rear services and was the driving force behind the unification of the central army's establishment; Chiang Baili and the officers of the General Staff Department took part in drawing up the plan of attack on the three axes. On the battlefield Liu Chih commanded on the Pinghan line, Chiang Ting-wen fought on the Jinpu line and Hsü Yuan-chuan pressed along the Longhai line, while the commanders of the Training Corps and of the divisions that grew out of it carried forward the offensive doctrine of this new-style formation. On the coalition side Yen Hsien-shan sat in Peking and made the Shansi-Suiyuan army, built on a base of many years' standing in Shansi, the core of his design to reorder the north; Feng Yuxiang was pushed forward as commander of the western route and was the real spiritual leader of the coalition, with his commanders Zhang Zhijiang and Sun Lianzhong holding the main bodies; his men fought whenever they had troops and rations, but where food ran out the units scattered and orders failed to get through. Yang Hucheng held Hsian with the Seventeenth Route Army and was the piece in the Kuanchung area whose move could decide the war. Two other figures proved decisive. Zhang Xueliang changed his mind and refused to aid Yen, cutting away the coalition's greatest outside support; Han Fuji and Shi Yousan took cash and appointments from Nanjing, and the coalition split at the moment it most needed to hold together; Li Zongren and Bai Chongxi kept the real strength of Kwangsi in their own hands and never committed the clique fully; and Chen Jitang ran his own course in Kwangtung and later turned towards Nanjing.
kits: 卡面上的線膛砲是前裝、線膛、以整裝藥包發射的野砲，一八五〇年前後的德國克虜伯七五公分野砲是它的原型；同樣藥量因線膛而走得更遠，射程可及數千公尺，砲兵第一次能以射程壓過步兵。到一九三〇年，這種前裝砲在技術上已被後膛砲取代，作戰主力是德製七五公分野砲與山砲、蘇製七六公分野戰砲、三十七公分野防步兵砲，以及一二〇公分與八二公分的迫擊砲，射程普遍在五千至六千公尺上下。中央軍步兵以德式毛瑟改進型步槍（中正造步槍在三十年代初仍處於試製與換裝之中）與德製水冷重機槍為主，舊式漢陽造步槍仍在流通；擲地炸彈是城鎮巷戰與村落攻奪的標準配備。空軍是蔣軍的另一半兵力，南京方面可用飛機二百餘架，包括美製輕轟炸機與教練機，負責偵察、對地轟炸與對地機槍掃射，直接介入濟南、鄆城一帶的地面決戰。運輸上，蔣軍以火車為家、以汽車接駁，形成鐵路加汽車的補給線；聯軍依賴地方徵糧、騾車、人力挑夫與馬匹，舊式前裝砲與老式迫擊砲在部分地方守軍手中仍是門面。攻城器材極少，雙方攻擊的對象多為車站、橋樑、堤口、寨牆與土圍子，能炸鐵路的炸藥、枕木與道釘反而是常用器材。
kitsEn: The rifled gun on the card is a muzzle-loading, rifled field piece fired with a single packed cartridge, modelled on the German Krupp 75 mm field gun of about 1850; the same charge of powder carried much further down the rifled bore, giving a range of several thousand metres, and for the first time artillery could outrange the infantry. By 1930 the muzzle-loader had been overtaken technically by the breech-loading gun, and the fighting strength of the day was made up of German 75 mm field and mountain guns, Soviet 76 mm field guns, 37 mm anti-infantry guns, and 120 mm and 82 mm mortars, with ranges generally in the region of five to six thousand metres. The central army's infantry was armed mainly with Mauser-derived rifles of the improved type, the Zhongzheng rifle still in trial production and gradual replacement in the early 1930s, and German water-cooled heavy machine guns, while old Hanyang-made rifles were still in service; hand grenades were the standard equipment of street fighting in the towns and of the assault on villages. The air force was the other half of Chiang's strength: Nanjing had some two hundred aircraft available, including American light bombers and trainers, responsible for reconnaissance, bombardment of ground targets and machine-gun strafing, and they took direct part in the deciding action around Jinan and Yuncheng. On transport the central army made the railway its home and used motor lorries for the shuttle, forming a supply line of rail plus road; the coalition depended on local requisition of grain, mule carts, human porters and pack animals, and the old muzzle-loading guns and older mortars in the hands of some local garrisons were still what they had to show. Siege equipment was scarce, and the objects of attack on both sides were mostly railway stations, bridges, embankments, village walls and earthen enclosures; explosives, sleepers and spikes for cutting the railway were in far more common use than anything else.
tactics: 蔣軍的打法是一套以鐵路為骨架的攻勢作戰：部隊以火車分批前送，落地即以步兵散兵線逐村、逐堡攻取，每佔一站便設守、向前滾動，戰線因此始終貼著隴海、平漢、津浦三條軸線推進；砲兵集中火力打擊車站、橋樑、堤口與土圍子，掩護步兵接近，攻堅時由教導總隊打先鋒，其分列進攻與火力準備的做法來自德國教練條令；空軍先掃清敵陣再作對地攻擊，濟南、鄆城一役正是陸空協同的模範。聯軍則以拖延與機動為主：破壞鐵路、遲滯蔣軍的車運與援軍，襲擊側翼與糧道，夜間以小股部隊突襲，進而在黃河渡口與寨牆後組織固守，再集中兵力於一點作突破口，不求全線同時得手。季節與地形也左右戰局：一九三〇年冬華北大旱，氣候乾冷而道路泥濘，火車與汽車的運輸效率都受牽制，聯軍在豫東平原上守點甚於野戰，蔣軍必須逐個解決被堅固寨牆與村莊改造成的據點，佔領線拉得越長，補給與警戒的負擔越重。
tacticsEn: Chiang's way of fighting was an offensive system built on a railway skeleton: the troops were moved forward in batches by train, and on detaching they took village by village and fort by fort with infantry in dispersed order, each station captured being garrisoned and the front rolled forward, so that the line of battle always hugged the three axes of the Longhai, Pinghan and Jinpu railways. The artillery concentrated its fire on stations, bridges, embankments and earthen enclosures to cover the approach of the infantry, and the Training Corps led the way in the assaults, its column advance and preparation of fire following German training doctrine; the air force first cleared the ground and then attacked, and the fighting at Jinan and Yuncheng was the model of land and air cooperation. The coalition fought by delay and manoeuvre: it cut the railway to hold up the central army's trains and reinforcements, struck at flanks and supply lines, made night attacks with small bodies of men, then dug in behind the Yellow River fords and village walls, and finally concentrated its strength on a single point to break through, never seeking a decision on the whole front at once. Season and ground told on the outcome as well. The winter of 1930 was a drought in north China, the air dry and cold but the roads muddy, which cut into the efficiency of both trains and lorries; on the open plains of eastern Henan the coalition held its points rather than manoeuvring in the open, and Chiang had to reduce one by one the strongpoints that village walls and farmsteads had been converted into. The longer the occupied line grew, the heavier became the burden of supply and outpost duty.
data: 可核對的數字可以標出這場戰爭的規模。時間上，聯軍起事與蔣軍展開討伐在1930年10月，聯軍主力崩潰在1931年5月，前後約半年，橫跨一個冬季。三條戰略軸線的長度也可核對：津浦鐵路自天津至浦口約一千公里，隴海鐵路自連雲港至天水全線約一千七百公里，平漢鐵路自北京至武漢約一千四百公里，蔣軍的推進正是沿這三條線的河南、山東兩段展開。兵力方面，蔣方在高峰期投入的師級單位約二十餘個，加上各省保安團與民團，總數在數十萬之譜；聯軍方面，晉綏軍、陝軍、桂系與魯冀各部的總數同樣以數十萬計，具體數字各方戰報說法不一。空軍是蔣軍的槓桿，可用飛機二百餘架，一次戰役可集結十數架至數十架次作戰。時間節點上，蔣軍於1930年12月攻入濟南，1931年1月攻入開封，其後推進至鄭州、洛陽一線，聯軍在潼關、華陰方向被壓回陝西。損失方面，聯軍被繳械與潰散的部隊以萬計，閻錫山事後只剩原有兵力的一半左右，馮玉祥的主力在中原損失殆盡；蔣軍的傷亡同樣以數萬計，而各方公布的戰果數字一向被指為誇大。
dataEn: A few checkable figures mark the scale of this war. In time: the coalition's rising and the opening of Chiang's punitive campaign belong to October 1930, and the collapse of the main coalition body to May 1931, some six months in all, straddling a single winter. The lengths of the three strategic axes can also be checked: the Jinpu railway runs some one thousand kilometres from Tientsin to Pukou, the Longhai railway about seventeen hundred kilometres from Lianyungang to Tianshui, and the Pinghan railway about fourteen hundred kilometres from Peking to Hankou; Chiang's advance followed precisely the Henan and Shantung stretches of these three lines. In men: the Chiang side committed on the order of twenty odd division-grade units at the height of the fighting, and with the provincial security brigades and local militia of the provinces the total ran to tens of thousands of men; on the coalition side the Shansi-Suiyuan army, the Shaanxi troops, the Kwangsi clique and the troops in Shantung and Hopei likewise added up to tens of thousands, though the exact figures differ from one set of battle reports to the next. The air force was Chiang's lever: some two hundred aircraft were available, and a single operation could bring together from a dozen to several dozen sorties. On the chronology: the central army entered Jinan in December 1930 and Kaifeng in January 1931, then pressed on to the line of Zhengzhou and Luoyang, driving the coalition back towards Tongguan and Huayin in Shaanxi. On losses: the coalition lost units by the tens of thousands, some disarmed and many simply dispersed; Yen Hsien-shan was left with roughly half the force he had brought into the field, and Feng Yuxiang's main body was virtually destroyed in the Central Plains. Chiang's own casualties were likewise counted in tens of thousands, while the battle results published by the different sides have always been accused of exaggeration.
cause: 起因是蔣介石要結束軍閥割據，而地方軍閥不肯交出地盤。一九三〇年前後，蔣推行國家本位主義，以統一編制、統一番號、統一軍費、統一稅收與統一徵購為手段，把各省的財政與物資逐步收歸中央，這直接動到以省為本位的軍閥生計。閻錫山在北平方面的挑釁更把衝突推向前台：他在1930年改易旗號、自任軍政府總司令，與兩廣呼應，蔣視之為公開割據，遂在北平撤換其官員、接收稅權，並向綏遠、察哈爾伸手；馮玉祥的西北軍長期缺糧缺餉，也需要一場勝負來解決兵員與裝備的生路。張學良的選擇是轉折點：他拒絕出兵援閻，使聯軍失去最大外援。同時蔣以現金與職位分化聯軍，韓復榘、石友三等先後受命，聯軍在最需要合力的時候先行瓦解。河南一帶連年災荒、軍需徵集激化，鄉村社會對長期徵發的不耐，成為亂局裡最直接的情緒來源。於是1930年10月聯軍通電討蔣，蔣隨即以軍事委員會名義發布討伐令，中原大戰全面開打。
causeEn: The cause lay in Chiang Kai-shek's determination to end the warlord partition and in the refusal of the provincial warlords to give up their ground. Around 1930 Chiang pressed the doctrine of the national standard, using the unification of establishments, unit designations, military pay, taxation and procurement to draw the finances and the material of the provinces back into the centre, which struck directly at the livelihood of warlords whose power rested on the province. The challenge from Yen Hsien-shan in Peking pushed the conflict to the front stage: in 1930 he changed the flag, proclaimed himself commander in chief of a military government and echoed the two Kwangsi provinces, and Chiang read this as open separatism, so he replaced Yen's officials in Peking, took over his tax revenues and reached towards Suiyuan and Chahar; the Northwestern Army of Feng Yuxiang, chronically short of food and pay, also needed a decisive battle to settle the question of men and equipment. Zhang Xueliang's choice was the turning point: he refused to send troops to aid Yen, and the coalition lost its greatest outside support. At the same time Chiang bought off men inside the coalition with cash and appointments, and men like Han Fuji and Shi Yousan took their orders in turn, so that the coalition came apart at the very moment it needed to hold together. The repeated disasters in Henan and the intensifying military requisitions left the rural population weary of constant levies, and that weariness was the most immediate mood behind the disorder. In October 1930 the coalition telegraphed its demand for Chiang's removal, and Chiang answered with a punitive order issued in the name of the Military Affairs Council, and the Central Plains War was fully under way.
impact: 中原大戰是蔣介石個人權力的頂點，也是國民政府以中央軍制勝地方軍閥的第一個大勝。取自河南、山東、安徽、河北的勝利，使中原各省在名義上歸於中央，蔣得以調動全線兵力投入1931年之後的剿共戰爭：中央蘇區自1931年起面對第一次大規模圍剿，寧都起義隨之挫折，蘇區的生存壓力成為往後幾年國民政府的首要內政議題。軍隊層面的改變更為持久：教導總隊在戰中擴編，日後成為中央軍骨幹，德械師的傳統由此確立；閻錫山退回山西，只剩不到一半的兵權，中央派員入晉掌握稅收與黨務，山西自此成為中央施壓的對象，晉綏系統在1935年華北事變中轉而與南京合作抗日；馮玉祥失去全部兵權並被扣留於南京，1933年在張家口組織抗日同盟軍，1934年之後逐步靠攏南京；桂系因保存實力而未受重創，李宗仁白崇禧仍據兩廣，蔣改以扶植陳濟棠來削弱廣西。與此同時，內戰把中原的鐵路樞紐牢牢釘進中央控制，也把整個華北平原暴露在中央軍的火力之下，1937年後的抗戰因此沿著同一條隴海線、津浦線反覆拉鋸。代價同樣明顯：國力被內戰大量耗用，民間負擔加重，1931年9月18日之後的東北局勢又使中央的統一成果迅速倒退。
impactEn: The Central Plains War was the high point of Chiang Kai-shek's personal power and the first great victory of the Nationalist government over the provincial warlords. The gains in Henan, Shantung, Anhui and Hopei brought the Central Plains provinces nominally under the centre, and Chiang was able to switch the whole line of effort to the war against the communists that followed in 1931: the Soviet area in central Jiangxi faced its first large encirclement campaigns from that year, the Ningdu Rising was defeated in its wake, and the survival of the soviet base became the leading domestic problem of the Nationalist government for the years to come. The change in the armed forces was the more durable one. The Training Corps expanded during the war and became the backbone of the central army, establishing the tradition of the German-equipped divisions; Yen Hsien-shan fell back to Shansi with less than half his troops, central officials entered the province to control taxation and party affairs, and Shansi became an object of central pressure, the Shansi-Suiyuan system later turning to cooperate with Nanjing in resistance during the North China crisis of 1935. Feng Yuxiang lost all his troops and was detained in Nanjing, only to organise the anti-Japanese volunteer army at Zhangjiakou in 1933 and to draw gradually closer to Nanjing after 1934. The Kwangsi clique, having kept its strength in reserve, was not badly hit, Li Zongren and Bai Chongxi still held the two Kwangsi provinces, and Chiang turned instead to propping up Chen Jitang in order to weaken Kwangsi. At the same time the civil war nailed the railway junctions of the Central Plains firmly into central control and laid the whole North China plain open to the guns of the central army, which is why the resistance war after 1937 was fought back and forth along the very same Longhai and Jinpu lines. The cost was no less plain: the country's strength was consumed in vast quantities by civil war, the burden on the population grew heavier, and after 18 September 1931 the situation in the Northeast reversed the gains of unification almost at once.
result: 蔣方全勝。1930年12月，蔣鼎文一部在空軍配合下攻入濟南，韓復榘部退回膠濟鐵路以北；1931年1月，中央軍進取開封，其後沿隴海線推進至鄭州、洛陽，陝軍退守潼關、華陰一線；閻錫山放棄平津，退回山西，聯軍的北方大本營就此瓦解。1931年5月，馮玉祥的殘部在關中被收編與潰散，馮本人應蔣之邀赴南京，兵權盡失，聯軍至此徹底瓦解。中原大戰留下的局面是：中央在名義上統一了豫、魯、冀、皖的軍政，鐵路沿線與主要城市直接落入中央軍控制之下，教導總隊擴充為中央軍的骨幹，各省保安團被整編進正規軍序列，舊日的地方軍閥多半降為旅團級的受編部隊。但統一只到這一層。東北仍由張學良自治，廣西由陳濟棠與新桂系分據，山西的閻錫山、青海的馬步芳、雲南的龍雲、新疆的盛世才各守一方，軍閥割據的格局並未真正改變；韓復榘等被收買者不久又與中央反目，1932至1933年間在魯西與蔣對抗。更大的轉折在戰後一年，1931年9月18日事變爆發，中央失去東北，中原大戰所奠定的優勢隨之動搖。
resultEn: The Chiang side won outright. In December 1930 the troops of Chiang Ting-wen entered Jinan with air support, and Han Fuji's men fell back north of the Jiaoji railway; in January 1931 the central army took Kaifeng and then pushed along the Longhai railway to the line of Zhengzhou and Luoyang, the Shaanxi troops withdrawing to hold Tongguan and Huayin; Yen Hsien-shan gave up Peking and Tientsin and fell back into Shansi, and with that the northern base of the coalition fell apart. In May 1931 the remnants of Feng Yuxiang's forces were disarmed and scattered in the Kuanchung area, and Feng himself came to Nanjing on Chiang's invitation, his troops gone for good; the coalition was then wholly dissolved. What the Central Plains War left was this: the centre had nominally unified the military administration of Henan, Shantung, Hopei and Anhui; the railway lines and the principal cities had passed directly under the control of the central army; the Training Corps had expanded into the backbone of the central army; the provincial security brigades had been brought into the regular order of battle; and most of the old provincial warlords had been reduced to brigades and regiments under central command. But the unification went no further than that. The Northeast remained autonomous under Zhang Xueliang, Kwangsi was divided between Chen Jitang and the new Kwangsi clique, and Yen Hsien-shan in Shansi, Ma Bufang in Chinghai, Long Yun in Yunnan and Sheng Shicai in Sinkiang each kept his own ground, so that the pattern of warlord partition was not truly altered. And the men Chiang had bought, such as Han Fuji, soon turned against the centre once more, holding western Shantung in opposition to Chiang in 1932 and 1933. The greater turning point came a year after the war: with the outbreak of the Mukden Incident on 18 September 1931 the centre lost the Northeast, and the advantage established by the Central Plains War was shaken with it.
